title: helianthemum nummularium subsp. tinetense
intro: Helianthemum nummularium subsp. tinetense, commonly known as Corsican rockrose, is a plant species within the family Cistaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help to soothe wounds and reduce the risk of infection. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant agent, making it useful for treating various skin conditions and promoting overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Helianthemum nummularium subsp. tinetense include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and diterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
